name: comp-146
title: Logo Card Checkbox
description: A bordered row with a green lightning logo, a service name with a grey category suffix and a two-line description; a small checkbox sits at the top right and the entire card clicks as one target.
use: Users pick one service or plan from a set and each option needs a logo, a name and a short explanation.
avoid: The card is fixed to Supabase copy and logo, and ticking only sets local checkbox state.
a11y: Label and description are tied to the checkbox and the logo is hidden, though the card itself has no focus outline. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark rounded card with a thin border sits on a near-black stage. A green bolt logo leads, then "Supabase" in bold beside a smaller grey "(Database)", with a grey description line beneath, and a small empty checkbox floats at the top right.
behaves: Hovering anywhere on the card lightens the checkbox and border; clicking anywhere ticks the checkbox and tints the card's border. The row acts as a single selectable option.
customise: No props: the SVG logo, service name, description and category suffix all live in the file, so a different integration means replacing them by hand.
weight: light: One card, a small inline SVG logo and a checkbox; no animation loop.
demo: Label "Supabase (Database)" and description "Sync auth, storage and Postgres from your Supabase project."
polishWhy: Clear card with a real logo and tidy text hierarchy; the checkbox is small beside it.
